scope: Pre-filter zero-step wrist/flange/palm topology, pose, margin and historic mounting-face tests; separate strict current wrist closest gate on every integrated step.
frame: G is the link frame of ip140_palm, determined from world COM and inverse local inertia transform
wrist_mesh_origin_geometry: URDF wrist collision xyz=(0,-0.0005,-0.0989), rotation X=pi/2
expected_static_interference: collision mesh extends past plane by 0.05945 mm before its 1 mm margin; use expanded wrist AABB and actual collision-face witnesses, not a blanket signed-distance exemption
rules: Only ordered or reversed exact same-body link IDs on the registered fixed path.
Both witnesses projected in y,z must lie within palm footprint and wrist expanded-box footprint.

Palm witness must belong to the back face or its 0.5mm rounded rim; its normal must have rearward x as unique dominant component. Wrist witness cannot project beyond CAD mesh extreme x plus its original 1mm collision margin.
Negative signed distances remain negative in logs. Axial overlap must be consistent with observed signed depth, normal and relative witnesses; non-mount pairs are processed by unchanged limits.

No force clipping. Persist pre-filter witness records and finite forces as observed. After the thirteen filters are set, any wrist/palm solver manifold fails. Missing closest witness, nonfinite data or an out-of-envelope pre-filter witness fails.

pre_filter_zero_step.geometry_audit: fixed chain, actual T_wrist_G, same-time closest and manifold witnesses

post_filter_zero_step_and_dynamic.solver_response: disabled for this exact named pair by one of thirteen documented setters
post_filter_zero_step_and_dynamic.verification: Post-filter zero requires closest witnesses and no manifolds. At EVERY physical step the current closest additionally requires signed d >= -1e-9 m, full vector witness residual <=1e-9 m, registered faces, relative pose and finite raw data. The historical static overlap is never a dynamic exception.
